updates.note: Management stated EBITDA margin will settle down at 26% to 27%.
Management stated growth in repair and overhaul will be around 5% to 6% from next year onwards.
updates.quote: from the next year onwards, the growth in the repair and overhaul will be at around 5% to 6%.

updates.note: Cash balance target not mentioned on this call.
Management confirmed delivering 3 aircraft (1 fighter and 2 trainers) during the current financial year.
updates.quote: In the current financial year, we are supposed to deliver 1 fighter and 2 trainer, total 3 aircraft during the current financial year.

new_promises.statement: Achieve double-digit revenue growth of 10% from FY25 onwards.
new_promises.quote: we will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Conclude estimated order value of INR 48,000 crores in the coming financial year.
new_promises.quote: we expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Deliver the first HTT-40 aircraft starting September 2025 with an average of around 20 aircraft.
new_promises.quote: it will start commencing from September 25 and an average delivery of almost 20 air crafts.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Conclude the AL-31FP engine order of INR 26,000 crores within the next 6 to 8 months.
new_promises.quote: We will be able to conclude it within the next 6 months to 8 months timeframe.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
